reasons: Candidate blocks with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING, which is the allowed outcome when no OTel metric measures the same quantity.

otel_metric_definitions is empty, so no OTel metric is shown for kafka.replication.isr_expands.rate or isr_shrinks.rate; the block cannot be checked against a real mapping and is accepted on that basis.
Both queries are rate-style Datadog kafka replication counters with no OTel definition supplied, so blocking the formula query1 - query2 is consistent with the hard rules.
